en.headline: Drivers trapped over two hours in Cityplaza car park gridlock
en.dek: Dozens of motorists were stuck in the basement car park at the Tai Koo Shing shopping centre on Sunday night and complained of being charged for the extra time.
body: Dozens of drivers were trapped in the basement car park at Cityplaza in Tai Koo Shing for more than two hours on Sunday night, with many expressing frustration online over the gridlock and parking charges for the extra time spent inside.

One driver who left from the B3 level around 8.30pm said they had already been stuck for 1.5 hours and ultimately waited over two hours to exit. Another who left at 7.30pm reported taking two hours to get out. Some said their cars had not moved for a full hour, while the customer service hotline remained constantly busy.

Drivers blamed vehicles trying to enter the car park for blocking the exit and said security staff allowed queue-jumping. One quoted customer service as attributing the problem to heavy rain making traffic direction difficult, a response that angered motorists who questioned why charges continued during the congestion. Some called the fees unreasonable and demanded compensation.

zh.headline: 太古城中心停車場塞車逾兩小時 司機抱怨仍要收費
zh.dek: 周日晚太古城中心地庫停車場出現嚴重擠塞，多名司機受困逾兩小時，並投訴因塞車多付的泊車費。
body: 周日晚太古城中心地庫停車場出現嚴重擠塞，數十名司機受困逾兩小時，不少人在網上表達不滿，指離開時仍被收取因塞車而延長的泊車時間費用。
一名由B3層離開的司機表示，約晚上8時30分離場時已受困1.5小時，最終等了超過兩小時才駛出。另一名約7時30分離場的司機則指花了兩小時才離開。有司機指車輛整整一小時完全未有移動，而顧客服務熱線一直繁忙。
司機指責有車輛試圖進入停車場而堵塞出口，並指保安容許插隊。有人引述顧客服務指大雨令指揮交通困難，此回應令不少人反感，質疑為何塞車期間仍繼續收費。部分司機認為收費不合理，要求補償。
